note: HYK-167 사이클0 D0-2 (B0 §3.1/§3.3): trusted canonical static role-profile root. This file's location (scripts/check/, alongside enforcement-inventory.json) IS the authority root for this repo -- a linked-worktree copy under a local .harness/ is NEVER authoritative, and launch-envelope.schema.mjs's validator enforces that by construction (it never consults cwd/git-toplevel/local .harness to pick which profile file wins; see launch-envelope.schema.mjs's SHADOW_AUTHORITY_DETECTED path). Cycle 0 scope: this is a STRUCTURAL CONTRACT only -- min_required_anchors/anchors declare what a role's launch envelope must carry, but no runtime here actually blocks a spawn against it (that is cycle 4, per task §0's explicit deferral list).

profiles.design_note: COMMON is not itself a launchable role -- it documents the baseline anchor set every other profile below repeats explicitly (no 'extends' mechanism was adopted this cycle; see this file's non-adoption note at the bottom, HG10).

PM writes into the control room and Linear (shared authority beyond its own worktree lane) -- classified high-authority so a future HIGH_ASSURANCE launch for this role is validator-blocked (LIMITED_DENY) without a capability_receipt.

CODER writes only inside its own dispatched worktree lane -- not classified high-authority; this cycle never grants it a HIGH_ASSURANCE entry in allowed_modes at all (stronger than requiring a receipt -- it cannot even attempt the mode).
Same shape as CODER -- REVIEW's authority (approving a commit-msg gate signature) is scoped to its own review file, not shared/external state.

VERIFY additionally carries selfcheck-freshness as ADVISORY (its weekly-loop posture checks, e.g. orca-posture-check, are VERIFY-owned per enforcement-inventory.json's 'owner' field) -- still not high-authority since it writes only its own report file.

ORCH owns the control room, dispatch, and packet-signing surface (enforcement-inventory.json 'owner':'ORCH' on the majority of entries) -- the highest-authority role in this set, hence high_authority_requires:true and clear-safe-check/controlroom-fresh (both ORCH-only-blocking per their post_hyk131_note) as REQUIRED rather than ADVISORY.

non_adopted_design_decisions: No profile 'extends'/inheritance field -- each role profile repeats the COMMON baseline anchors explicitly instead of referencing profile-common-v1. Rationale: an extends chain adds a second place validateEnvelope would need to resolve before judging REQUIRED-anchor counts, and this cycle's scope is a flat structural contract (task §0); revisit only if profile drift across roles becomes a real maintenance problem.

No per-anchor severity beyond the four classes (REQUIRED/ADVISORY/CONDITIONAL/OUTPUT) -- e.g. no numeric weight or partial-credit scheme. Rationale: B0 §3.1's four-class enum is the signed contract; a finer scheme is unrequested scope creep for cycle 0.

CONDITIONAL class is declared in the schema/enum but no profile below uses it yet -- left available for a future role/anchor pairing (e.g. an anchor required only under HIGH_ASSURANCE) rather than removed, since HG10 prefers declaring the shape now over silently omitting it.
